title: OS installation
content:
# OS installation

Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS is installed remotely through iDRAC virtual media, using the automated installer configuration from the deployment repository.

## Attach the installer image

```
racadm remoteimage -c -u <SHARE-USER> -p <SHARE-PASSWORD> -l //10.60.0.30/isos/ubuntu-24.04-live-server-amd64.iso
racadm remoteimage -s
```

## Boot from it once

```
racadm set iDRAC.ServerBoot.FirstBootDevice VCD-DVD
racadm set iDRAC.ServerBoot.BootOnce Enabled
racadm serveraction powercycle
```

Watch progress in the iDRAC virtual console. When the installation finishes, detach the image:

```
racadm remoteimage -d
```

## After installation

- ☐ Hostname and OS address match [[Server inventory]]
- ☐ Both 25 GbE ports bonded and connected to both site switches
- ☐ Data drives pooled as described in [[Storage layout]]
- ☐ Server joined to the container cluster and visible in monitoring
